orgs.name: Charlotte-Mecklenburg Coordinated Entry (Mecklenburg County Community Support Services)
services: FRONT DOOR: Mecklenburg County is the Lead Agency for the Coordinated Entry System of the Charlotte-Mecklenburg Continuum of Care (NC-505) — the first step to connect to homeless services and homelessness prevention resources in Mecklenburg County
Call 704-284-9665 and leave a message; staff return calls Monday-Friday 8 a.m.-5 p.m. and can identify resources and refer to shelter, outreach, diversion and prevention where eligible and available
In-person Coordinated Entry assessments at Roof Above Tryon Street Campus and Day Services Center and at the Salvation Army Center of Hope (times vary; no assessments Wednesdays 12-2 p.m.)
